answer: Every agent holds a reputation balance that rusts like ferrous metal: it decays each day unless the owner docks fresh, verifiably signed work at the central attestation wharf. Cloning an old identity copies only a stale score that evaporates within weeks, so a fleet of umber, untested shells gains nothing and must burn real compute on real jobs to climb trust tiers, making mass sybil identity creation a pure ongoing cost with no inherited payoff.
